name: analytics_run_report
description: Run a GA4 aggregated report (e.g. event counts by eventName over a date range).

end_date.description: End of date range, relative ("today") or "YYYY-MM-DD"

property_id.description:
GA4 property id (numeric, e.g. "521849462" — not the
Firebase project id)

start_date.description: Start of date range, relative ("7daysAgo") or "YYYY-MM-DD"
